feed.title: Two critical PHP flaws let attackers run code without logging in
feed.sum: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. Patches are out for supported PHP versions; older releases face a harder upgrade.
feed.why: A real story about checking systems before trusting them. Protect, Challenge, Verify.

feed.title: OpenAI says GPT-5.6 Sol helped find one of the PHP flaws
feed.sum: Wiz independently found both. OpenAI calls the gap between AI finding a bug and public disclosure a "Defender's Window."
feed.why: AI as the defender, with humans running disclosure. Good proof point for human-in-the-middle.

feed.title: Finland, the BBC and Edinburgh council take pages offline over the PHP flaws
feed.sum: Finland temporarily shut government web services while patching.

feed.title: Anthropic opens a waitlist for Claude Duet, a proactive agent that asks before acting
feed.sum: US research preview for Pro and Max subscribers, on web, iOS and Android.
feed.why: An everyday AI helper that still asks first. Exactly the CUEPA for You promise: you stay in the middle.

feed.title: Kognitos launches 61 role-based "AI employees" for finance teams
feed.sum: Backed by 515 standard procedures. A new agent, Quill, drafts procedures for a human to approve.
feed.why: The market is selling AI that drafts and humans approve. CUEPA does that for small businesses, not just enterprise finance.

feed.title: Needle adds outbound sales to AI coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor
feed.sum: Runs lead generation and outreach across LinkedIn, Instagram and email. Priced per connected sender account, not per lead.
feed.why: Agent-driven outreach is arriving fast. ŌLLIN GO's angle: one next step, done right.

feed.title: OpenAI models and Codex are coming to Google Cloud
feed.sum: Available through Model Garden and Google Cloud Marketplace. General availability is planned "in the coming weeks."
feed.why: A buying signal: companies on Google Cloud can now buy OpenAI directly. Watch who moves.

feed.title: Anthropic proposes a law letting Commerce seek court orders to suspend dangerous AI models
feed.sum: It would apply to models that cross set catastrophic-risk thresholds. Open questions remain on who does the testing.
feed.why: AI accountability is your beat. Who should hold the off switch?

feed.title: Hyro rebrands around "Agentic Care" with Care OnCue
feed.sum: For patient access, IT, billing and basic clinical support. The company reports 300 million+ interactions across 2,500 healthcare sites.

feed.title: Google DeepMind researchers resign over military AI work
feed.sum: Research engineer Sofia Liguori left this week; researcher Andreas Kirsch left earlier in October. Google says public-sector contracts go through compliance reviews.
feed.why: Values now drive who stays and who leaves. A hiring story, not just a tech one.

feed.title: Recursive's Flint coding model runs 125+ tokens a second on a MacBook Pro
feed.sum: 39.8 billion parameters, about 2.5 billion active per token. Speed figures are company-reported.

feed.title: HeyGen Voice Turbo ranks first in Artificial Analysis' voice ranking
feed.sum: Elo 1,202. API price drops to $4 per million characters, from $30 for its last voice model.

feed.title: Mistral and NVIDIA team up on AI for industrial engineering and chip design
feed.sum: Plans include public datasets and benchmarks for AI agents doing computer-aided engineering.

feed.title: Youth group asks for independent AI testing and liability by end of 2027
feed.sum: Design It For Us drew on 700+ members across 40 states.
feed.why: Users want AI that's tested and safe for them. NENEMI is built that way for ADHD brains.

feed.title: GM plans an OnStar AI that runs errands, starting with the 2027 Cadillac Lyriq
feed.sum: Longer term it would coordinate personal tasks alongside self-driving.

feed.title: UseIt Studio: a design agent that outputs print-ready packaging files
feed.sum: Asks follow-up questions, then delivers files with dimensions, bleed and dielines for packaging, stickers and cards.

feed.title: Perplexity trains one model to be both teacher and student
feed.sum: Called JOLT. Perplexity reports gains in math, coding and agent tasks but published no figures.
